system.description: With a sharp yank on a person's fate, the Sidereal can dislodge that person's name and snatch it from them. This Charm functions like Sidereal Shell Games: the player rolls (Manipulation + Larceny) against a difficulty equal to the target's permanent Essence. On success, the victim is truly disassociated from the stolen name in the eyes of all observers—mortals, spirits, and Exalted alike cannot perceive or find the victim in relation to that identity. Any type of name may be targeted with this Charm, including given names, titles, and sobriquets; each separate name requires a separate use. The Sidereal may use the stolen name as if it were her own; in the context of a resplendent destiny or mundane disguise, it counts as truthfully hers.
